message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural roads, 45 mph on urban roads.
• 70 mph on interstate highways (except where posted otherwise).
• 65 mph on rural freeways, 55 mph on urban freeways. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Children under 5 must be in a rear‑seat child safety seat. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed.
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (0.02% BAC).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• “Right‑of‑way” rules for school buses, emergency vehicles, and construction zones. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during any weather that reduces visibility.
• Fog lights are allowed only when visibility is less than 200 ft. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Towing & Vehicle Registration** | • Vehicles must display valid registration stickers.
• Towing regulations require proper equipment and safe towing practices. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Parking** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or on sidewalks.
• Parking in a handicap space requires a valid handicap placard. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **School Bus Rules** | • All vehicles must stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• No passing a stopped school bus. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers.
• Overtake only when safe and legal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Vehicle Safety Equipment** | • Must have working brakes, lights, horn, and mirrors.
• Tires must be in good condition and properly inflated. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for bodily injury per accident, $25,000 for property damage. | Texas Department of Insurance – Motor Vehicle Insurance | | **Special Situations** | • **Construction Zones**: Follow posted signs and reduced speed limits.
• **High‑way Interchanges**: Use proper lane discipline and merge safely. | TxDOT Construction Zone Guidelines | --- ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The official source for all statutes. *Website:* https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/ | 2. **TxDOT Traffic Safety** – Offers educational materials, videos, and updates on new regulations. *Website:* https://www.txdot.gov/ | 3. **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)** – Provides licensing, registration, and insurance information. *Website:* https://www.txdmv.gov/ | 4. **Local County Courts** – For specific case law or recent rulings that may affect local traffic enforcement. | --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always keep your headlights on** during low‑visibility conditions. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to make calls. - **Check your mirrors** before changing lanes. - **Observe posted speed limits**—they can change quickly near construction or in school zones. - **Keep your vehicle’s registration and insurance documents** in the car at all times. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law, recent changes, or how to handle a particular traffic situation!
